description: Who holds a stock or ETF listing, by kind of 13F filer, quarter by quarter: each bucket's share of 13F common shares, its like-for-like change, and new and exited filers. Split by holder type (regulatory records, never names), measured style, turnover, horizon, 13F book size, client base, private funds or location. Also gives the active holders' like-for-like change, which leaves index-like books out. The fundtype dimension instead splits registered funds' Form NPORT-P positions by their Form N-CEN fund type (index funds, index ETFs, active ETFs, active funds, unclassified) as a share of shares outstanding; fund positions sit inside their advisers' 13F reports, so they are never added to 13F totals.

dimension.description: How to split the holders: type (holder type, default), style, turnover, horizon, aum (13F book size), client (client base), pf (private funds), country (filer location), fundtype (registered funds by N-CEN fund type, from N-PORT, as a share of shares outstanding)

maxPeriods.description: Quarters to show, newest last (default 4, clamped to 1-12)
